description: Telegram workspace M1 per DESIGN §14 (CR-003): component kit and typed Bot API 10.1-10.3 adapter, topics and flat mode, menu scopes, pinned dashboard, routing table, the review flow S1-S12 (PR title never cut), the CR-004 presentation (proposal cards, size line, rescope and ceiling cards, /work and link cards, /size, /filters), the full command set with pickers (CR-001 lifecycle, CR-002 /egress, /hermes tier, /skills and the skill card, /model and the new-model card), notifications and offline states. steps: Item 44: Kit and plumbing (§14.18, §14.10, §14.17; rows CR3-D1, D2, D3, D12, D13, D16, D20 adapter = ADR-0020b, CR3-U1, U2, U3, U6 placement, U8, U9, CR3-AC-1, 2, 3, 12, 13, 14, 25, 26, 37, CR3-BA-6, BA-7, TGRW-10, TGRW-12, TGRW-13, TGRW-14, CR3-V-1, 4, 12, 14, 15). `telegram/ui/{kit,blocks,classic,rich,sanitize,limits,icons,send}.py`, `telegram/rawapi.py` (typed 10.1–10.3 payloads over `do_api_request`), `escape.defuse_commands`/`sanitize.undefuse`, `config/telegram.yaml` + schema via the snapshot, topics with flat fallback, menu button and per-state command scopes, the pinned dashboard, `telegram/routing.py` (normative routing table; non-command updates to the chat backend; GitHub links to link cards), import-linter contracts of §14.20.1.

Item 45: Review flow S1–S12 (§14.11.1–§14.11.14; rows DES-FR-5, DES-AC-14, CR3-D4 to D7, CR3-AC-4 to 11, 23, 30, 32, 44, 45, 49, 52, 53, 56, 60, CR3-BA-11, BA-13, CR3-F6-1, CR3-F6-6, TGRW-7, P1-4 UI part). Decorated S1 per kind with the size line and `👤` marker, explorer, file views and diffs, `.patch` and HTML diff documents, comments and the draft review, interdiff (S6) with `/package` interdiff, S7 edit title/body/comment (policy check first), S8 approve/confirm (`confirm_text`), S9 submitted, S12 stale, `/queue` ordering; the PR title is never cut (256-char test) and mockups 01/03 are updated to show the full title; copy-title length check. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 2: add src/ossbot/gatekeeper/migrations/0002_phase2.sql (tables pending_input(id, kind CHECK IN ('changes','edit_title','edit_body','reject_other','edit_comment'), cid, approval_id, prompt_message_id, chat_id, created_at, expires_at, consumed_at) and chat_sessions(tg_user_id PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at)); register it in the db migrations runner. Write src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/pending_input.py (create on ForceReply send, 15 min TTL, match only a message whose reply_to_message.message_id == prompt_message_id in the owner chat, single consumption). In handlers.py add the purposes changes, edit_title, edit_body, clear_edits, reject_reason, give_up_fix, stop_watch, stop_watch_confirm (names from the ui_tokens comment in 0001_init.sql): Request changes -> ForceReply 'Describe the change (<= 4000 chars)' -> change_requests row + AWAITING_APPROVAL->CHANGES_REQUESTED via state_machine + old card edited 'superseded by change request'; Edit title/body (and edit_comment for comment/claim bodies) -> ForceReply with the current text quoted -> P1-4: run policy.check_text (confidentiality floor, secret patterns, disclosure, title 1-256 single line, body <= 60000) on the edited text and refuse with the reason BEFORE ApprovalService.set_text_override stores anything -> new card via ctx.on_approval_created, old approval invalidated; Clear my edits -> overrides NULL + new card; Reject -> reason keyboard [Not valuable] [Wrong approach] [Repo unsuitable (cooldown)] [Other…], Other -> ForceReply (<= 500 chars), Repo unsuitable -> repo_overrides.cooldown_until = now + 7 d; Give up on this fix / Stop watching (+confirm) per §9.12 transitions. Non-reply free text is handed to the chat relay hook (item 4). Tests: tests/telegram/test_pending_input.py, tests/telegram/test_edit_flows.py (edited body with a confidentiality-floor value or without the disclosure is refused and nothing is stored; edited title with a newline refused; wrong reply target ignored; expired prompt ignored; replayed token no state change).

Item 46: CR-004 presentation (§14.11.15–§14.11.19, §14.14.4; rows CR3-D18, D19, D22, CR3-U13, CR3-AC-38, 39, 40, 41, 43, 50, 51, 54, 61, 62, 63, CR3-BA-8, BA-12, CR4-1e UI, CR4-2b UI, CR4-2i UI, CR4-2k, CR4-2l UI). Proposal card and versions with the deterministic diff, decline and Undo, RESCOPE and ceiling cards, `/work` and link cards with notes, `/size` (`xs`…`xl`, per-repo `inherit`, ceiling read-only), `/filters` (4 pages).

Item 47: Controls, notifications and states (§14.13, §14.14, §14.15, §14.16; rows DES-FR-6, CR1-5c commands, CR2-2a UI, CR2-3a UI, CR2-3d UI, CR2-7b, CR2-7k, CHAT-12 UI, CR3-D11, D14, D15, CR3-U7, CR3-AC-16, 17, 21, 33, 34, CR3-F6-5, CR3-V-*  (UI items)). The full §14.14.1 command set with pickers and confirmation patterns (`/drain /undrain /down /up`, `/egress`, `/hermes tier`, `/skills` + skill card, `/model` + new-model card, `/reload`, `/repos`, `/limits`, `/logs`, `/settings`, `/quiet`, `/notify`, `/new`), priorities P0–P3, quiet hours, coalescing and batching (never for rows with buttons), offline and killed states, short-description updates. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 3: the remaining §14.5 commands in new modules src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/commands/{review.py,admin.py,lifecycle.py} imported by handlers.py like builtin: /queue (read; contributions grouped by state with one 'open card' button per pending approval -> /approve flow), /approve <cid> (read; N4: one transaction invalidates every ui_tokens row of the old card(s), resets armed->pending, re-sends the card as a NEW message, mints tokens only after send + body parts delivered, edits the old card 'moved to a newer message'; expired -> live checks re-run, fresh approval row), /reject <cid> [reason] (config, confirm), /reload (go: shows the config diff of POST /v1/config/reload dry form, confirm applies), /repos [filter] (read; per-repo Enable/Disable/Allow AI buttons are config + confirm, writing repo_overrides), /limits and alias /budget (read; limits + 24 h usage + per-role invocation counts from stage_runs), /logs <cid> [stage] (read; last 40 redacted lines + the log as a document), /newchat (read; chat_sessions.n += 1). CR-001: /drain (stop, immediate: ControlService.drain scope workers), /undrain (go, confirm: ControlService.up), /down (stop, immediate: gatekeeper writes /var/lib/ossbot/control/lifecycle-request {action:'down', scope:'workers', actor, ts, nonce}), /up (go, confirm: same request file with action 'up'). Root side: scripts/bin/ossbot-lifecycle (self-contained bash like scripts/bin/ossbot-resume: request owned by gatekeeper, regular file, <= 4 KiB, ts <= 5 min old, jq-validated, always consumed; 'down' runs /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/ossctl down --scope workers --kind graceful, 'up' runs ossctl up and is refused while killed), systemd/ossbot-lifecycle.path (PathExists=/var/lib/ossbot/control/lifecycle-request) + systemd/ossbot-lifecycle.service (root oneshot, TimeoutStartSec=300, TimeoutStopSec=150), both added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS in scripts/lib/services.sh. /status keeps the lifecycle + poll-health line and adds running stages, last anchor and kiro-cli/Hermes versions when known. setMyCommands from registry.menu() at bot start (if not already done in telegram/bot.py); outbox honours 429 retry_after (verify outbox.py; add if missing). Tests: tests/telegram/test_commands.py (every command, safety class enforced: go/config never act without the confirm tap; /approve rotation N4), tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_lifecycle.py (request file contents), tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py (new units), extend tests/system/test_lifecycle.sh with the Telegram path (trigger through the gatekeeper API as ossadmin operator: runner/hermes/sandboxd stopped, gatekeeper still active, then up).
